job.title: Content Producer
job.description:
A fantastic opportunity to join a fast-growing financial services brand on a growth trajectory. We are looking for a creative, hands-on Content Producer to help scale its organic social presence and paid advertising.

You’ll work directly alongside the founder to build a high-volume content engine across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Meta ads.

This is a hands-on production role, you’ll be behind the camera, developing creative concepts, testing new formats and helping build the systems required to produce content consistently at scale.

What You’ll Do
  • Plan and structure weekly content production, including preparation and shooting of materials
  • Shoot high-volume short-form organic content and paid ad creative
  • Produce long-form YouTube/podcast-style content and repurpose it across social platforms
  • Test different ad formats, hooks, angles and creative concepts
  • Work closely with the founder on creative direction and content strategy
  • Brief and direct an offshore editor to maintain quality and consistency
  • Learn and apply Meta Ads Manager to help optimise campaign performance
  • Help build a scalable content production system across various touch-points of the business
What We’re Looking For
  • 4–5 years’ experience creating content and recording ads, ideally for service-based businesses.
  • Strong camera and shooting skills with the ability to capture various formats
  • Good editing knowledge and an understanding of what makes content perform
  • Experience working with or directing editors when required
  • Comfortable producing high volumes of content and moving quickly
  • Creative, proactive and willing to test new ideas
  • Interested in learning the paid advertising side of the business, from in-platform planning and placement to campaign performance
  • A systems thinker who wants to build processes, not just execute individual shoots
  • Comfortable working closely with a founder in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
The long-term goal is to build an in-house media team. Strong performance across organic social and paid advertising will create an opportunity for this role to grow into a leadership position as the media function scales.

Location: Parramatta (Sydney) 
Type: Full-time, onsite (some flexibility may be agreed)
Salary: $100 - 120k + super

If you’re a content producer who loves being behind the camera, thrives on volume and wants to develop your skills across creative strategy and paid media, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now by submitting your CV online.

job.title: Content Marketing Specialist
job.description:
We’re looking for a Content Marketing Specialist to join a high-performing growth team and drive activity across key marketing channels. You'll have demonstrated experience driving audience acquisition & retention through meaningful content (email, organic social & paid media) as well as partnership marketing and broader communications initiatives. 

This is a hands-on, generalist marketing role for someone who enjoys both strategic thinking and execution. You’ll have the opportunity to shape audience strategy, create compelling content, build and optimise campaigns, analyse performance and turn ideas into action.

You’ll be joining a purpose-led business with a fantastic culture. They are growing across multiple international markets and on a mission to use business as a force for good.

The Scope:
  • Own the strategy and execution of a key audience engagement channel, developing ways to increase engagement, conversion and long-term audience value.
  • Plan, write, build and optimise regular audience communications, including segmentation, testing, QA and performance analysis with the data team.
  • Identify opportunities to evolve audience activation through lifecycle communications, re-engagement and other targeted initiatives.
  • Create compelling content across channels, including social, customer case studies, press releases, reports and other brand content.
  • Support product marketing initiatives by translating product launches and updates into clear, engaging communications for customers.
  • Contribute to SEO/AEO and broader organic growth initiatives.
  • Support brand collaborations, partnership campaigns and other growth projects as they arise.
  • Work closely with Product, Growth and other teams to turn ideas and insights into effective marketing campaigns.
  • Bring a generalist mindset to a small, fast-moving team, balancing planned activity with ad-hoc projects and changing priorities.
About You:
  • 4–5 years’ experience in content marketing, lifecycle/CRM or a similar generalist marketing role.
  • A strategic mindset combined with a strong bias towards execution, you can develop the strategy and then get into the detail to make it happen.
  • Excellent copywriting and editing skills, with the ability to adapt your voice for different audiences and channels.
  • Confidence using AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, editing and content production while maintaining a high standard of quality.
  • Hands-on experience with any email platforms such as Mailgun, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Braze or similar would be favourable.
  • Experience with CMS platforms and digital marketing tools.
  • Working knowledge of SEO/AEO and analytics platforms such as GA4, Search Console or similar.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage recurring campaigns alongside ad-hoc projects in a fast-moving environment.
  • Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to get stuck in — this is a role where priorities can shift and no two weeks will look exactly the same.
  • An interest in a purpose-led business and social impact is critical.

Location: Sydney | Full-time | 4 days x onsite, 1 flexible day.
Salary: Up to 100k + super + benefits

This is a rare opportunity where you'll have meaningful ownership, plenty of room to experiment and the chance to work across a broad range of marketing initiatives, while contributing to a business with a strong social purpose. You'll be joining an ambitious, passionate (and fun) team as they scale for this next phase of growth.

Apply now by submitting your CV as requested.

job.title: Social Content Creator & Editor
job.description:
Social Content Creator & Editor

This is a great opportunity to join an Australian food company that is leading the industry across direct-to-consumer and retail markets. Our client fuels active individuals—from elite athletes to everyday people—with award-winning, high-protein meals, snacks, and drinks. The brand at the intersection of food, fitness, health, culture, and lifestyle, and as they enter an ambitious next phase of growth, they're looking for a standout creator-editor to help shape how this iconic brand shows up in social culture.

If you're a highly skilled, content creator-editor with the ability to independently create, shoot, present, and edit high-performing short-form content, then this role could be just what you're looking for. Reporting straight into the Head of Social, Content & Community, this hands-on role will be responsible for editing a high volume of social content each week. You'll also become one of the recognisable, regular faces of the brand across TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms
.
What You’ll Do:
  • Produce weekly content: Edit a high volume of original videos, cut-downs, creative variations, and platform-specific versions.
  • Transform raw assets: Turn raw footage, creator submissions, influencer content, and campaign assets into polished, platform-native content.
  • Master advanced CapCut: Utilise CapCut at an advanced level to produce distinctive, high-retention vertical videos.
  • Craft engaging narratives: Build strong hooks and narrative structures that capture attention within the opening seconds.
  • Apply creative judgement: Maintain excellent pacing, captions, sound design, music, transitions, comedic timing, and clear calls to action.
  • Optimise across platforms: Adapt content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and paid social channels.
  • Front social content: Build familiarity as a recognisable, natural, and engaging brand personality on camera.
  • Host versatile formats: Appear in taste tests, product reviews, lifestyle challenges, street interviews, and behind-the-scenes content.
  • Engage the community: Interview athletes, creators, and community members in gyms, kitchens, offices, and public events.
  • Own the creative process: Take content independently from initial idea and scripting through to filming and final delivery.
  • Mobile-first filming: Capture high-quality content using an iPhone-first, mobile-native approach.
  • Direct talent: Guide team members, influencers, and ambassadors during shoots to capture natural performances.
  • Monitor digital culture: Stay deeply connected to emerging creators, memes, sounds, editing styles, and platform algorithms.
  • Optimise via analytics: Use reach, watch time, completion rates, and audience signals to iterate and improve future creative output.
What You’ll Bring
  • Experience: 4–6+ years creating and editing social content in-house for a brand or within a social/creative agency.
  • CapCut expertise: Advanced proficiency in CapCut is essential; experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, or Canva is highly regarded.
  • Proven portfolio: A strong showreel or social media presence demonstrating high-retention vertical video creation.
  • On-camera confidence: Natural presence on camera with the ability to bring personality to content without making it feel forced or corporate.
  • Industry alignment: A genuine, demonstrated personal interest in fitness, food, nutrition, health, and active living.
  • Production stamina: Ability to manage multiple edits simultaneously and thrive in a fast-moving, high-volume production environment.
  • Platform knowledge: Deep understanding of social search, accessibility practices (keywords, captions, alt text), and evolving platform algorithms.
Perks On Offer
  • On-site gym: Access to a fully equipped, on-site fitness facility.
  • Staff discounts: Generous discounts on premium meals, snacks, and drinks.
  • Modern facility: Work from a new state-of-the-art facility with on-site parking.
  • Work-life balance: Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
  • Culture: Robust recognition and reward programs alongside quarterly business off-sites.
Sheryn Small | Lead Consultant | iknowho.com.au

job.title: Account Director | Integrated Creative Agency
job.description:
Account Director | Integrated Agency 
 
This successful creative agency has an opportunity for a polished Account Director with the strategic smarts to lead clients toward successful outcomes for both their business and the agency.Reporting directly to a Client Partner while mentoring an Account Manager, this role offers plenty of room for career growth.

Over the past few years, this agency has produced iconic, award-winning campaigns, offering plenty of creative opportunity.Managing new brand launches, product rollouts, and large-budget multi-channel campaigns will be second nature to you, as will developing a deep understanding of the client’s business, brand, category, and vision.

 
What You’ll Do
  • Drive Creative Excellence:  Lead and manage ambitious above-the-line (ATL) campaigns—protecting the creative vision through development, client approval, production, and launch.
  • Lead Senior Client Relationships: Own the day-to-day partnership with the client's marketing leadership. Manage expectations honestly, sell big ideas, and navigate challenges with confidence.
  • Run Major Shoots & Campaigns: Partner early with Creative and Production on scope and budget, leading major end-to-end shoots including talent, locations, and on-set decision-making.
  • Mentor & Champion Talent: Lead, guide, and develop an Account Manager, creating clear pathways for their career growth.
  • Commercial Ownership: Manage account profitability, scoping, job cost reconciliations, and resource forecasting.
What You Bring
  • Agency Experience: 5+ years in agency account service, currently operating as an Account Director or a Senior Account Manager ready to take the next step.
  • Multi-channel campaign track record: Proven experience delivering large-scale national campaigns, including full end-to-end TVC production.
  • Commercial & Presentation Polish: Strong commercial acumen and the ability to sell bold creative ideas to senior stakeholders 
  • Leadership & Drive: A proactive, fearless mindset, paired with humility and genuine pride in growing junior team members.
Why You’ll Love It Here
  • High-Impact Work: Build work that dominates screens and stands out in culture.
  • Open-Door Leadership: Enjoy continuous 360-degree feedback, dedicated development appraisals, and an accessible leadership team that backs your growth.
  • Creative Freedom: Work in an environment where bold ideas are protected and brought to life (and pets are welcome!)
Ready to make the best work of your career? Apply now.
